doc: CLI tools and runtimes Orbit knows how to find and, where a verified private install exists, how to install into the machine store. Immutable data shipped with the plugin: an upgrade may change a row, never what a person installed. `detection` says where to look, `install.strategy` which installer runs. An `archive` install is PINNED here, version and SHA-256 per platform, so nothing fetched at install time decides what is trusted.

tools.name: Node (Orbit Control)
tools.summary: runs Orbit Control, which needs Node >= 24.15

tools.name: Git
tools.summary: source control; the engine reads the checkout through it

install.instructions: Install Git from https://git-scm.com/downloads or your operating system's package manager. Orbit does not install it: it belongs to the whole machine.

tools.name: GitHub CLI
tools.summary: reads issues, pull requests and repositories from GitHub as the signed-in user (gh)

install.instructions: Install the GitHub CLI from https://cli.github.com or your operating system's package manager. Orbit does not install it: it belongs to the whole machine.

tools.name: Azure CLI
tools.summary: the Azure CLI found on this machine -- Orbit uses it as a program only, never its sign-in (az)

install.instructions: Install the Azure CLI from https://learn.microsoft.com/cli/azure/install-azure-cli or your operating system's package manager. Orbit does not install it: it belongs to the whole machine.

tools.name: Azure CLI (Orbit's own copy)
tools.summary: a copy of the Azure CLI Orbit keeps for itself, in an environment of its own: the official release, every package pinned and hash-checked (macOS and Linux)

tools.name: Azure CLI (Orbit's own copy, Windows)
tools.summary: the official Azure CLI ZIP package, unpacked into Orbit's own directory -- no administrator rights, nothing on PATH (Windows x64)

tools.name: Playwright CLI
tools.summary: drives the browser for UI test runs (playwright-cli)

install.instructions: The engine runs playwright-cli from PATH. `node <plugin>/cli/setup.mjs --install` installs @playwright/cli with npm -g, which changes this machine's global npm; a project may instead add @playwright/cli to its own devDependencies. Orbit Control never installs it for you.
